last_episode_to_air.name: Mid-Atlantic Championship Wrestling - May. 17, 1986
last_episode_to_air.overview: On this edition of Mid-Atlantic Championship Wrestling, NWA World Heavyweight Champion Ric Flair sends a message to everyone. Plus, The Road Warriors, Wahoo McDaniel, Jim Cornette's Midnight Express, and many more take to the ring for action!

name: Mid-Atlantic Championship Wrestling
overview: Relive the glory days of the National Wrestling Alliance through Mid-Atlantic Championship Wrestling's weekly television show.
